import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n = data[0]
h = data[1:]

left_max = [0] * n
right_max = [0] * n

for i in range(1, n):
    left_max[i] = max(left_max[i - 1], h[i - 1])

for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
    right_max[i] = max(right_max[i + 1], h[i + 1])

    1
    for i in range(n)

)
